sourceContext: R13 schema-state reconciliation; supersedes terminal CP51-06 BLOCKED.
objective: Certify the exact minimal database, RLS, RPC, grants and storage delta required for release 698c using schema-state reconciliation between the verified local Production backup restore and a clean target reference database, without mutating Production.
why: The backup migration ledger is unavailable; historical migrations must not be replayed blindly. Reconcile actual baseline schema state to the clean release target.
scope: Build a clean target reference from the repository migrations.
Introspect and normalize baseline and target schema state.
Apply and verify only the reconciliation candidate in an isolated local restore.
Run independent DB, RLS, RPC, storage and release-dependency reviews.
Publish the structured terminal gate result.
acceptanceCriteria: Target and candidate normalized contracts are equivalent.
Reviewers report P0=0, P1=0 and P2=0.
forbiddenActions: create or alter Production storage buckets or policies
change Production RLS, grants, RPCs or schema
stopConditions: Any step would require a Production mutation.
Required backup or isolated restore cannot be safely identified.
Target reference cannot be built cleanly.
Any reviewer reports P0, P1 or P2.
A credential or secret would need to be exposed.
verificationRequirements: Produce normalized object matrix for tables, columns, indexes, constraints, triggers, RPCs, RLS, grants, storage and extensions.
Apply and test only reconciliation SQL against the isolated candidate restore.
Prove baseline immutability and rollback recreation.
